question: As per the PIB report, which of the following National Telemedicine Services has served more than 36 crore patients through teleconsultation by 6 April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**eSanjeevani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **eSanjeevani** is the flagship **National Telemedicine Service** of **India**, developed and managed by the **Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW)**.
 
• According to a **Press Information Bureau (PIB)** report, the platform has achieved a historic milestone by facilitating more than **36 crore teleconsultations** for patients across the country by **6 April 2025**.
 
• The service was designed to provide **healthcare access** to citizens in **remote** and **rural areas**, effectively bridging the **digital health divide** between urban and rural populations.
